title: 기본 모음 6개 한 번에: ㅏ ㅓ ㅗ ㅜ ㅡ ㅣ
objective: Say the six basic vowels clearly and write each one with ㅇ in the right place.
summary: Read and write the six basic Korean vowels ㅏ ㅓ ㅗ ㅜ ㅡ ㅣ.

task.title: Read and write vowels
task.line: Say each item out loud first, then choose or write your answer.

letters.as: ㅏ like 'a' in father; ㅓ like 'u' in cup, jaw open.
ㅗ: small round lips, 'o' in go without 'w'; ㅜ like 'oo' in moon.
ㅡ: say 'oo' with flat, unrounded lips; ㅣ like 'ee' in see.

letters.letter: 아 어 이 / 오 우 으
letters.as: Silent ㅇ fills the empty spot: ㅏㅓㅣ go right, ㅗㅜㅡ go below.

exercises: Choose the right romanization: ① 아 (a / o) ② 우 (u / eu) ③ 이 (i / eo)
Write the syllable. Put ㅇ in the empty spot: ① ㅇ + ㅓ ② ㅇ + ㅡ ③ ㅇ + ㅗ
Write the word in Hangul from its sound (use silent ㅇ): ① [ai] 'child' ② [oi] 'cucumber' ③ [i] 'tooth'
Choose the syllable that matches the sound: ① [eo]: 어 / 오 ② [u]: 우 / 으 ③ [a]: 아 / 이
answers: ① a ② u ③ i
① 어 ② 으 ③ 오
① 아이 ② 오이 ③ 이
① 어 ② 우 ③ 아
